initiatives.name: Senior Leadership Restructuring
initiatives.summary: SSE made executive hires in IT, Procurement, Legal, Sustainability and Business Development areas. Helen Mahy stepped down from the Board after nine years, with Hixonia Nyasulu becoming Senior Independent Director.

evidence.title: Rhian Kelly Appointed Chief Sustainability Officer
evidence.summary: Rhian Kelly joined SSE as Chief Sustainability Officer in 2025, bringing significant sustainability experience from National Grid and the CBI. She leads climate, environmental, and sustainability initiatives to support SSE's net zero transition goals.
evidence.quote: Rhian has been Chief Sustainability Officer since joining SSE in 2025. She brings significant sustainability experience from prior roles at National Grid, where she led international climate, environmental, strategic public policy, and inclusion initiatives.

evidence.title: Senior Leadership Changes
evidence.summary: SSE made executive hires in IT, Procurement, Legal, Sustainability and Business Development areas. Helen Mahy stepped down from the Board after nine years, with Hixonia Nyasulu becoming Senior Independent Director.
evidence.quote: I'm excited by the arrival of executive hires in the areas of IT, Procurement, Legal, Sustainability and Business Development.

evidence.title: Tracey Wood to Replace Liz Tanner as Company Secretary
evidence.summary: Following Liz Tanner's intention to retire, Tracey Wood was appointed as her successor as Group General Counsel and Company Secretary from late 2026. This change ensures continuity in legal and governance leadership during strategic growth phase.
evidence.quote: Within the year, Liz Tanner, our Group General Counsel and Company Secretary signalled her intention to retire. Following a competitive recruitment process, a recommendation was made to appoint Tracey Wood as her successor from late 2026.

initiatives.name: Chief Executive Transition
initiatives.summary: Martin Pibworth was appointed as Chief Executive following the AGM, succeeding Alistair Phillips-Davies after his 28 years at SSE. Pibworth brings depth of sector knowledge and commercial acumen from his long-standing career at SSE.

evidence.title: Martin Pibworth Appointed Chief Executive
evidence.summary: Martin Pibworth was appointed as Chief Executive following the AGM, succeeding Alistair Phillips-Davies after his 28 years at SSE. Pibworth brings depth of sector knowledge and commercial acumen from his long-standing career at SSE.
evidence.quote: As announced last year, we welcomed Martin Pibworth to the role of Chief Executive following the AGM in July 2025.

evidence.title: Martin Pibworth Appointed as New Chief Executive
evidence.summary: Martin Pibworth was promoted from Chief Commercial Officer to Chief Executive on 17 July 2025, replacing Alistair Phillips-Davies. The leadership transition was part of strengthening senior management to drive strategic ambitions and navigate the challenging external environment.
evidence.quote: Martin Pibworth was promoted from Chief Commercial Officer to Chief Executive on 17 July 2025.

initiatives.name: Community Investment Programmes
initiatives.summary: SSE delivered a record year for community investment with £24.9m awarded through community funds, exceeding the previous ambition of £10m per year. The company has doubled the ambition to at least £20m annually from 2026.

evidence.title: Record Community Investment Fund Awards
evidence.summary: SSE delivered a record year for community investment with £24.9m awarded through community funds, exceeding the previous ambition of £10m per year. The company has doubled the ambition to at least £20m annually from 2026.
evidence.quote: Total community investment increased from £16.3m in 2024/25 to £24.9m in 2025/26, largely driven by the first awards from the new Generation Green and Yellow River funds in Ireland, alongside significant growth in established funds such as the Viking Community Fund.

initiatives.name: £33bn Five-Year Investment Plan
initiatives.summary: SSE announced a fully-funded five-year investment programme to transform UK's electricity infrastructure. Around £22bn will be invested in electricity transmission networks in north Scotland and £5bn in distribution networks.

evidence.title: £33bn Five-Year Investment Plan
evidence.summary: SSE announced a fully-funded five-year investment programme to transform UK's electricity infrastructure. Around £22bn will be invested in electricity transmission networks in north Scotland and £5bn in distribution networks.
evidence.quote: Our £33bn fully-funded five-year investment plan will transform the UK's electricity infrastructure and deliver long-term benefits for society. Of that, we plan to invest around £22bn in the electricity transmission network in the north of Scotland.

evidence.title: £33bn Five-Year Investment Plan Acceleration
evidence.summary: SSE accelerated its investment strategy with a fully-funded £33bn investment plan announced in November 2025. This represents the next stage of the Net Zero Acceleration Programme Plus, focusing on UK electricity networks and renewable energy infrastructure to support Clean Power 2030 goals.
evidence.quote: Strategic discussions in 2025/26 were pivotal in the Board's decision to accelerate investment in UK electricity networks and the ultimate shaping of the £33bn, fully-funded investment plan, announced in November 2025. This five-year investment plan represents the next stage of the earlier Net Zero Acceleration Programme Plus, and was agreed following review and discussion of the opportunities available to SSE's businesses.

initiatives.name: Female Leadership Diversity Achievement
initiatives.summary: SSE achieved its target of 40% female representation within the Group Executive Committee and its direct reports by October 2025. The company continues working toward 6% ethnic minority representation in senior leadership by December 2027.

evidence.title: 40% Female Representation in Senior Leadership Achieved
evidence.summary: SSE achieved its target of 40% female representation within the Group Executive Committee and its direct reports by October 2025. The company continues working toward 6% ethnic minority representation in senior leadership by December 2027.
evidence.quote: We are proud to have achieved our ambition of 40% female representation within the GEC and its direct reports by October 2025. However, we recognise there is always more work to do, with a key priority monitoring progress towards our ambition of 6% ethnic minority representation in senior leadership by December 2027.

initiatives.name: Workforce Efficiency and Headcount Optimization
initiatives.summary: SSE's total headcount decreased from 15,819 to 15,197 following a period of organizational change and efficiency measures. The company conducted extended collective consultation with more than 1,200 employees but enabled over 700 potentially affected employees to move into new roles.

evidence.title: Headcount Reduction Following Efficiency Review
evidence.summary: SSE's total headcount decreased from 15,819 to 15,197 following a period of organizational change and efficiency measures. The company conducted extended collective consultation with more than 1,200 employees but enabled over 700 potentially affected employees to move into new roles.
evidence.quote: At 31 March 2026, our total headcount was 15,197¹,down from 15,819 the previous year. This follows a period of sustained headcount growth of nearly 50% between 2021/22 and 2024/25.

initiatives.name: Immersive Safety Training Programme
initiatives.summary: SSE expanded its immersive safety training programme, with over 14,000 colleagues, contingent workers and contract partners attending since 2022. The programme reinforces safety leadership through real-life examples and contributes to stronger safety culture across operations.

evidence.title: Immersive Safety Training Programme Expansion
evidence.summary: SSE expanded its immersive safety training programme, with over 14,000 colleagues, contingent workers and contract partners attending since 2022. The programme reinforces safety leadership through real-life examples and contributes to stronger safety culture across operations.
evidence.quote: It was pleased that participation had continued to increase, with more than 14,000 colleagues, contingent workers and contract partners attending since 2022. Through careful design to ensure relevance to the broad range of our operational settings, the programme reinforces safety leadership through real-life examples.

initiatives.name: Tarbert Next Generation Power Station
initiatives.summary: SSE is constructing a 300MW power station in Co. Kerry that will be the first in Ireland to run on Hydrotreated Vegetable Oil from waste feedstocks. The project has secured €335m of revenues through a 10-year capacity agreement.

evidence.title: Tarbert Next Generation Power Station Construction
evidence.summary: SSE is constructing a 300MW power station in Co. Kerry that will be the first in Ireland to run on Hydrotreated Vegetable Oil from waste feedstocks. The project has secured €335m of revenues through a 10-year capacity agreement.
evidence.quote: Construction is under way at the 300MW Tarbert Next Generation power station, targeting full commercial operation from October 2027. The station has secured €335m of revenues through a 10-year capacity agreement.

initiatives.name: Platin Power Station Development
initiatives.summary: SSE took final investment decision on a 170MW power station in County Meath with preparatory works under way. The project is underpinned by a 10-year capacity agreement valued at around €250m plus an additional €20m for natural gas capability.

evidence.title: Platin Power Station Final Investment Decision
evidence.summary: SSE took final investment decision on a 170MW power station in County Meath with preparatory works under way. The project is underpinned by a 10-year capacity agreement valued at around €250m plus an additional €20m for natural gas capability.
evidence.quote: Final investment decision was taken on Platin, a 170MW power station in County Meath, in July 2025, and preparatory works are under way with full site mobilisation expected in the coming months, targeting full commercial operation from October 2028.

initiatives.name: Transport for London Solar Partnership
initiatives.summary: Transport for London appointed SSE Energy Customer Solutions as partner to deliver a first-of-its-kind private wire solar project for the London Underground. The project could generate up to 65,000MWh annually and cover two-thirds of the Victoria line's electricity demand.

evidence.title: Transport for London Solar Partnership
evidence.summary: Transport for London appointed SSE Energy Customer Solutions as partner to deliver a first-of-its-kind private wire solar project for the London Underground. The project could generate up to 65,000MWh annually and cover two-thirds of the Victoria line's electricity demand.
evidence.quote: Transport for London (TfL) has appointed SSE Energy Customer Solutions as its partner to deliver a first-of-its-kind private wire solar project for a major urban transport network, connecting rooftop and ground-mounted solar installations directly to the Tube.

initiatives.name: UK Corporate Governance Code 2024 Compliance
initiatives.summary: SSE implemented new procedures and governance structures to comply with UK Corporate Governance Code 2024 Provision 29 requirements. This includes enhanced monitoring of risk management framework effectiveness and material controls testing, with full compliance required from financial year 2026/27.

evidence.title: UK Corporate Governance Code 2024 Compliance Implementation
evidence.summary: SSE implemented new procedures and governance structures to comply with UK Corporate Governance Code 2024 Provision 29 requirements. This includes enhanced monitoring of risk management framework effectiveness and material controls testing, with full compliance required from financial year 2026/27.
evidence.quote: Management has implemented and operates processes for the ongoing monitoring and review of: the effectiveness of the risk management and internal control framework, and oversight of all assurance outcomes across three lines of defence including the operation and testing outcomes of material controls.
